name: Hen egg white, raw
source: Proximate composition (per kg): water 875.7 g, protein 109.0 g, fat 1.7 g, ash 6.2 g, carbohydrate by difference 7.4 g, typical of raw hen egg white (USDA FoodData Central pattern).
notes: Same conversion method as hen-egg-whole. Egg white is almost fat-free and its ash is sodium- and potassium-led, unlike the yolk, which is phosphorus- and iron-led.
